Name: Skell's Misc. Furniture
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]I had a few pieces of furniture lying around in my folders so I decided to compile them and add a few more to make this pack! This mod uses AT's new "Collective Names" feature, so make sure you have the LATEST version of AT installed. 

[/size][size=3]Placing the objects/paintings will randomly pick one of the textures, however, if you'd like to set a specific texture, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the object while equipping the bucket and pick the texture of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. 

[/size][color=#cc4125][size=5][b]TO PLACE THE COUCHES OUTSIDE: [/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]You can install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url] to place the couches outside to use the motorcycle, as they usually wouldn't be placed.[/size]

[color=#cc4125][size=5][b]The furniture you can use: [/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]- Lg. Futan Bear/Junimo Plush/Gourmand Statue 
- All couches
- All small decor (globe, decorative bowl, etc.)
- All small wall decor (jungle decal, starport decal, banners, etc.)
- All big wall decor (Jade Hills, Queen of the Gem Sea, etc.)[/size]

[color=#cc4125][size=5][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over Vortex)
4. Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder[/size]
[b]
[/b]
